title: Benchmarking Peptide-Protein Affinity Prediction Across Peptide and Target Shifts
abstract: arXiv:2608.30175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Peptide-protein affinity models are often evaluated with a single data split, obscuring whether they interpolate among measurements for observed targets or generalize across peptide or target shifts. We integrated three sources of quantitative peptide-protein binding data to obtain 11,349 deduplicated pairs and benchmarked ten peptide representations, ESM-2 protein embeddings, and six regressors under peptide-similarity, within-target, and leave-target-out partitions. Across 60 matched representation-regressor configurations, mean test Spearman correlations were 0.462, 0.669, and 0.530, respectively. The top configuration shifted from ECFP-16 count fingerprints with random forest in the first two settings to HELM-BERT with Extra Trees when exact target sequences were excluded. translated_title: 跨肽与靶标偏移的肽-蛋白亲和力预测基准测试
translated_abstract: 肽-蛋白亲和力模型通常仅通过单一数据划分进行评估，这掩盖了模型是在已观测靶标的测量值之间进行插值，还是能够跨肽或靶标偏移实现泛化。我们整合了三个定量肽-蛋白结合数据来源，获得11,349个去重配对，并在肽相似性、靶标内和留靶标外三种划分下，对十种肽表示方法、ESM-2蛋白嵌入以及六种回归器进行了基准测试。在60个匹配的表示-回归器配置中，平均测试Spearman相关系数分别为0.462、0.669和0.530。最优配置从前两种设置下采用随机森林的ECFP-16计数指纹，转变为排除精确靶标序列时采用Extra Trees的HELM-BERT。表示方法的排名相关系数在各划分间介于-0.042至0.624，而回归器的排名相关系数介于0.771至0.943。学习曲线显示...
tldr: 该研究构建了整合多源数据的肽-蛋白亲和力大规模基准，系统评估了表示方法与回归器在肽和靶标分布偏移下的泛化表现，发现回归器选择较为稳健，而表示方法的优劣高度依赖于数据划分方式。
en_tdlr: This work establishes a large-scale peptide-protein affinity benchmark across peptide and target shifts, revealing that regressor choice is robust while representation performance varies dramatically depending on the data split.
